personajes.en: Afro-Colombian man, short black curly hair, thin mustache, brown skin. Faded blue polo shirt, dark jeans, worn sneakers, cheap black helmet with visor. Holds a phone mounted on a motorcycle handlebar, dust on his boots.

Mestiza woman, deep wrinkles, gray hair in a low bun, sun-tanned brown skin. Worn floral blouse, cropped trousers, rubber boots, shoulder cloth bag. Swings a machete with a taped wooden handle, red dust on her clothes.

Afro-Colombian man, receding gray hair, thick gray mustache, dark brown skin. Short-sleeve checked shirt open over white undershirt, beige trousers, sandals. Carries a scale by its chain, white plastic sacks of produce beside him.

Zenú mestizo young man, straight black hair slightly long, copper-brown skin. White school-style polo, jeans, colorfully woven mochila strap across his chest, sneakers. Holds a battered notebook and cheap earbuds around his neck.

Afro-Colombian woman, black braided hair tied back with a kerchief, dark skin, round face. Light tank top under an apron, ankle-length skirt, rubber sandals. Lifts a steaming aluminum pot lid, wooden spoon and fried plantains visible.

Mestiza woman, black hair under a straw hat with wide brim, warm brown skin. Long-sleeved faded shirt, rubber boots, jeans rolled at the ankle, rubber apron. Carries a stainless milk jug, rope lasso coiled at her hip, grass stains on boots.

Mestizo man, short straight black hair, olive-brown skin, lean build. Sweat-stained white undershirt, rolled paint-splattered work trousers, worn boots, sun-faded cap. Holds a masonry trowel, measuring tape clipped to his belt, cement dust on sleeves.

Afro-Colombian elderly woman, short white curly hair, dark brown skin, slight hunch. Neat lavender blouse with small collar, pressed gray skirt, low flat shoes. Holds a worn voter-style folder of papers and a small Catholic rosary, glasses on a chain.
